scenes.title: How to install a Ring Alarm Pro 14-piece kit
scenes.body: Our real install in Chantilly, VA. About 2 hours.

scenes.title: Base station, keypads, sensors & more
scenes.body: Contact sensors, motion detectors and a range extender.

scenes.title: Before you start
items: A central spot for the base station
scenes.body: Always follow the instructions in your Ring box.

scenes.title: Plug it in and follow the app
scenes.body: Alarm Pro has eero Wi-Fi built in: use it as your router or join your network.

scenes.title: Put it in a central spot
scenes.body: The closer to the middle of the home, the better every sensor reaches it.

scenes.title: Step 2 · Pair before you mount
items: Add the device in the Ring app
scenes.body: Pairing first means no ladder work twice.

scenes.title: Sensor and magnet, lined up
scenes.body: Mount one piece on the door, the other on the frame, close together.

scenes.title: Do the same on windows
scenes.body: Sash and frame, lined up, so it alerts the moment it opens.

scenes.title: Cover every door that leads outside
scenes.body: Then the windows you use most.

scenes.title: High in a corner, about 6–8 ft up
scenes.body: Point it at the room, away from heaters and windows.

scenes.title: Mount it by the main door
scenes.body: Plug it in or use the battery, then set your access codes.

scenes.title: Step 6 · Test everything
items: Check the alerts on your phone
scenes.body: Not sure about any step? We install it for you.
